description: A squat civic building of poured concrete and tall dark windows, set back off Kessler Street a single door north of Precinct 9. Chiselled above the lintel, half-legible under decades of grime: HALL OF RECORDS · COLDWATER MUNICIPAL. A brass slot beside the door reads DEPOSIT DEEDS HERE; someone has scratched underneath it, OR WEEP. Kessler Street runs past to the east; the door faces it, standing open as it usually does — step in off the road and the noise falls away behind you.
name: Hall of Records
